title: Emerging Launch Radar Pipeline Input
description: Pulls GitHub trending repos and Hacker News launch / front-page stories over your window, joins them per project, and scores cross-platform momentum 0-100. Optionally adds Product Hunt (needs your own token) and domain WHOIS/MX enrichment.

keywords.title: Keywords / topics
keywords.description: Optional. Narrows the Hacker News search (and Product Hunt, if on) to these terms. Leave empty to take the whole GitHub trending list plus the HN feeds below. Examples: ["ai agent", "vector db", "devtool"].

githubTimeframes.title: GitHub trending timeframes
githubTimeframes.description: Which GitHub trending lists to pull. daily catches the freshest movers; weekly/monthly are steadier.

githubLanguages.title: GitHub languages
githubLanguages.description: Optional language filters for GitHub trending, e.g. ["python", "typescript", "rust"]. Empty pulls all languages.

hnFeeds.title: Hacker News feeds
hnFeeds.description: Which HN feeds to pull. Valid: show (Show HN launches), top (front page), best, new, ask, jobs. Default show + top is the launch / traction signal.

hnMaxAgeHours.title: Hacker News max age (hours)
hnMaxAgeHours.description: Ignore HN stories older than this. 168 = one week of launches.

minStarsInPeriod.title: Minimum GitHub stars in period
minStarsInPeriod.description: A project with fewer stars-in-period than this AND below the HN points floor (and no Product Hunt votes) is dropped as noise.

minHnPoints.title: Minimum Hacker News points
minHnPoints.description: HN points floor used by the same noise gate as above.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Hard cap on rows pulled from each source per run. Controls total cost (each child also bills per row).

includeProductHunt.title: Add Product Hunt source
includeProductHunt.description: Optional third signal. When on AND you supply your own Product Hunt developer token below, launches are joined in as a corroborating source. Off keeps the run token-free.

productHuntToken.title: Product Hunt developer token
productHuntToken.description: Your own Product Hunt developer token. Create one at https://www.producthunt.com/v2/oauth/applications. Only used when the toggle above is on.

productHuntTopics.title: Product Hunt topics
productHuntTopics.description: Optional Product Hunt topic slugs to scan, e.g. ["developer-tools", "artificial-intelligence"].

includeDomainEnrichment.title: Add domain WHOIS + MX enrichment
includeDomainEnrichment.description: Optional. Runs domain-intelligence on each project's domain so rows carry registrar, domain age, and whether the domain has mail (MX) for outreach. Adds child cost.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy passed to the child actors. GitHub and Hacker News do not require a proxy.
